changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud CCE Environment Assessment skill.
- Collects metrics and configurations from Huawei Cloud container environments and generates comprehensive assessment reports.
- Provides step-by-step workflow: environment configuration, environment check, information collection, metric scoring, and report generation.
- Strict execution rules for step confirmations, file storage, permission handling, and status tracking.
- Emphasizes using Huawei Cloud KooCLI for all information collection.
- Outputs actionable suggestions for aligning applications with cloud-native best practices.
summary: A skill for huawei cloud container(CCE) assessment. It automatically collects metrics and configurations from containerized application environments on Huawei Cloud to generate a comprehensive assessment report. Use this when users want to evaluate if their Huawei Cloud applications align with cloud-native best practices and identify areas for improvement.
